plan.p_fork_stacki: Start Cauldron Astro as a fork of the MIT Stacki repository at commit 363b044, keeping its licence and attribution. Keep its Astro project opening, live preview, source-aware page editing, selection, style controls and undo machinery.
plan.p_safe_saves: Before any agent work, make stylesheet and general source saves carry the version they were based on, through forward saves and Undo/Redo. Refuse or merge when the disk no longer matches. Add a regression test: visual CSS edit, then an unrelated outside CSS edit, then Undo; the outside edit must survive.
plan.p_preview_refresh: Fix the new-page preview so a created page shows without a manual reload, after tracing the actual cause with a test.
plan.p_preview_isolation: Audit and restrict what the preview frames can access, so a user's website or third-party scripts in it cannot use the editor's internal bridge. Give preview frames only a minimal height-reporting channel.
plan.p_shared_actions: Create one set of project actions (read the selection, read a page outline with its version, targeted element edits, CSS rule edits, create page) used by the visual controls, the integrated agent and external agents alike. Every write states the version it was based on; stale writes return a clear conflict instead of saving.
plan.p_agent_runs: Group each agent's changes into a run with a plain summary of which pages and files changed. Allow undoing a whole run; refuse when later work changed the same parts, and show what conflicts.
plan.p_agent_panel: Add an agent conversation panel with equal prominence to the visual editor, using resizable and collapsible panels so both fit at small window sizes. It runs the agent tool the user already has with the current selection as context, keeps the session going between messages, and shows running, failed and finished states. Make one agent work end to end before adding others.
plan.p_external_access: Expose the same project actions to external agents through a local MCP server bound to 127.0.0.1 with a per-project session token, plus small install guides per agent tool.
plan.p_outside_edits: When a file changes on disk: merge automatically only when the changes do not overlap; otherwise keep both versions and ask the user to choose, never silently discarding either. Use one written conflict policy for every save path, with tests.
plan.p_recovery: Save unsaved edits to a recovery area outside the project every few seconds, offer them back after a crash, and clear them only after a verified save.
plan.p_content_forms: Edit content collections through forms built from the project's Astro schemas, showing when the schema information is out of date, with raw editing as a fallback.
plan.p_design_package: Provide a structured design-direction package: chosen references, typography, colour and spacing tokens, curated licence-compatible sections, and good and bad examples with reasons. Both the visual editor and the agent use it.
plan.p_output_checks: Build the real Astro site and run measured checks: responsive overflow, keyboard navigation, automated accessibility, broken links and performance under stated conditions. Keep advisory visual critique separate from measured results.
plan.p_git_publish: Show changed files and publish through the user's own Git remote. Block pull or publish while files have unsaved edits. Never commit or push without the user asking.
plan.p_distribution: Ship an unsigned Mac download with first-launch instructions, and test it on a separate Mac. The Astro editor has never been packaged, so packaging is a task in its own right.
plan.p_clean_room: Treat Sitereal and Zeku as idea references only. Write Cauldron's own behaviour specifications in plain words; do not use their extracted code or code excerpts while implementing, and keep their extracted files out of the Cauldron repository.
plan.p_byok_later: Decide on optional bring-your-own-key only after the integrated and external agent paths work, based on actual need.
